title: A strengthening of the Nyman–Beurling criterion for the Riemann hypothesis
doi_scope: DataCite identifier for the arXiv preprint
publication_status: Original arXiv preprint inspected. Relation to the published journal article verified by title, author, main theorem and the precise Balazard–Saias estimate in the indexed journal scan.
journal_relation_scope: Journal form adds a section on a constructive approximating sequence, with distinct numbering and pagination. Direct bdim PDF download returned HTTP 503. The indexed journal scan displayed Lemma 1 and equation (2.1) on p. 6.
version_history: The v2 arXiv comment reports three typographical corrections and one added reference.
read_scope: Partial close reading of §§1–3 of arXiv v2, covering the main criterion, the quoted Möbius estimate, the quotient estimate and the ordered norm limits. Journal Lemma 1 was located independently in the indexed scan.
main_result: Theorem 1.1 in arXiv v2, and Theorem 1 on journal p. 5. RH is equivalent to the indicator of (0,1] lying in the closed L²(0,∞) span of the fractional parts {1/(nx)} for positive integers n.
reusable_lemma: ArXiv v2 Lemma 2.1, p. 3, equation (2.1), and journal Lemma 1, p. 6, equation (2.1), reproduce the fixed-gap Möbius approximation of PAPER-E007, Lemme 2, for any zero-free half-plane Re(s)>b, 1/2≤b<1.
selection_reason: Original source for the discrete Báez-Duarte criterion and a verified formula-complete quotation of the Balazard–Saias lemma used in the corrected weighted criterion.
